accepted_actions.action: Make numeric contextual colon selection recognize tabular digit alternates.
accepted_actions.independent_evidence: Re-shaped 12:34, 00:00, 99:59 at wght400/opsz14 in current TTF. Default chooses colon.case (y=205..1239); tnum chooses colon (y=-10..1024). Exactly 215 units downward shift, 1.47px at 14px. a:b retains colon in both modes. Arbitration image inspected and shift is visible.
accepted_actions.acceptance_test: On actual TTF and WOFF2, shape 12:34, 00:00, 99:59 with tnum on/off across representative extremes and interior axis locations. Both numeric modes should choose colon.case; a:b retains colon; equal tnum digit advances and fixed-format timer widths remain unchanged.

accepted_actions.decision: accept fallback integration validation; reclassify from font defect
accepted_actions.action: Keep the declared 189-codepoint scope. Validate locale strings against the README system-fallback policy; use U+00A0 in authored currency strings as documented.
accepted_actions.acceptance_test: In the intended browser with actual WOFF2 loaded and CSS font-family: Tabuna Sans, system-ui, sans-serif, render 1\u202f234,56 €, 1\u2009234.56, and documented 12\u00a0480,00\u00a0₽. Confirm no tofu, verify computed/rasterized fallback where applicable, check U+202F nonbreaking behavior in a narrow container, and check repeated fixed-format values keep grouping and decimal alignment under tabular-nums. Repeat on target systems; font-only HarfBuzz .notdef for out-of-scope characters is expected and cannot certify fallback.
accepted_actions.status: proposed test, not executed in this critique

rejected_actions.reason: Adding U+202F/U+2009 is outside fixed 189-codepoint scope and is not an authorized design requirement. My original alternative to add glyphs was too broad in this scope.
The initial acceptance criterion required no .notdef in single-font shaping, which cannot be met under current deliberate scope. It must be replaced by actual system-fallback integration validation.

reconciliation.numeric_width_pass: Retained. Initial 960 passes measured format parity, missing glyphs within selected in-scope samples, equal digit advances, and full-string widths. These are compatible with vertical misalignment.
reconciliation.vertical_alignment: Not covered by the timer-width pass. Initial contexts actually recorded colon glyph ID 43 default versus 42 tnum; I did not flag the vertical change. The initial report therefore missed this defect and must not be interpreted as a complete timer visual pass.
reconciliation.ui_verdict: conditional, now expressly conditional on ENG-001 contextual-colon correction for timer usage.
reconciliation.headings_verdict: conditional for timer-containing headings; original sampled numeric-heading pass was too broad because it included timers without comparing tnum off/on.
reconciliation.body_verdict: conditional unchanged; out-of-scope coverage is an integration limitation, not a font defect.

retained_observations: DATA-02 O/0 visual similarity remains an identifier-use limitation; an optional zero alternate is a future design choice, not a mandatory scope change.
DATA-03 small-size weight advice agrees with README 400–500 starting policy; no additional font engineering action required.
limits: Independent reproduction here is at one axis location; engineering report supplies wider-grid reproduction.
